en: I thought I was very nervous yesterday in my mood.
zh: 我以為我昨天心情非常緊張。
ja: 昨日はとても緊張していると思っていました。
local: I thought I was very nervous yesterday in my mood.
ja_pron: Kinō wa totemo kinchō shite iru to omotte imashita.
native: I thought I was very nervous yesterday in my mood.

en: Over 2000 years ago, ancient Chinese scholars observed the changing patterns in our natural
zh: 兩千多年前，古代中國學者觀察了我們自然界中變化的模式，
ja: 2000年以上前、古代の中国の学者たちは自然界の変化するパターンを観察しました。
local: Over 2000 years ago, ancient Chinese scholars observed the changing patterns in our natural
ja_pron: Nisen nen ijō mae, kodai no Chūgoku no gakusha-tachi wa shizen-kai no henka suru pātān o kansatsu shimashita.
native: Over 2000 years ago, ancient Chinese scholars observed the changing patterns in our natural

en: world, the climate, the turning of the seasons and astronomy.
zh: 世界、氣候、季節的更替和天文現象。
ja: 世界、気候、季節の移り変わり、そして天文学を。
local: world, the climate, the turning of the seasons and astronomy.
ja_pron: Sekai, kikō, kisetsu no utsurikawari, soshite tenmongaku o.
native: world, the climate, the turning of the seasons and astronomy.

en: The scholars measured and divided the sun's annual movements into 24-4 parts, creating the 24 solar terms, which were used to govern agriculture in ancient China.
zh: 學者們測量並將太陽的年度運動分為24個部分，創造了24節氣，這些節氣用於管理古代中國的農業。
ja: 学者たちは太陽の年間の動きを24の部分に分け、24節気を作り出し、古代中国の農業を管理するために使いました。
local: The scholars measured and divided the sun's annual movements into 24-4 parts, creating the 24 solar terms, which were used to govern agriculture in ancient China.
ja_pron: Gakusha-tachi wa taiyō no nenkan no ugoki o 24 no bubun ni wake, 24 sekki o tsukuridashi, kodai Chūgoku no nōgyō o kanri suru tame ni tsukaimashita.
native: The scholars measured and divided the sun's annual movements into 24-4 parts, creating the 24 solar terms, which were used to govern agriculture in ancient China.

en: Even to this day, this invention still guides the lives and traditions of hundreds of millions of Chinese people.
zh: 直到今天，這項發明仍然指導著數億中國人的生活和傳統。
ja: 今日に至るまで、この発明は数億人の中国人の生活と伝統を導いています。
local: Even to this day, this invention still guides the lives and traditions of hundreds of millions of Chinese people.
ja_pron: Kyō ni itaru made, kono hatsumei wa sū oku-nin no Chūgokujin no seikatsu to dentō o michibiite imasu.
native: Even to this day, this invention still guides the lives and traditions of hundreds of millions of Chinese people.

en: Around June 6 every year, among John Solar Tower,
zh: 每年6月6日左右，在約翰太陽塔附近，
ja: 毎年6月6日頃、ジョン・ソーラー・タワーの周辺で、
local: Around June 6 every year, among John Solar Tower,
ja_pron: Maitoshi 6-gatsu 6-nichi goro, Jon Sōrā Tawā no shūhen de,
native: Around June 6 every year, among John Solar Tower,

en: at this time, the already busy farming season reaches its peak, paying thanks to the flower gods and making wine with fresh plum berries,
zh: 此時，已經忙碌的農忙季節達到高峰，感謝花神並用新鮮的梅子釀酒，
ja: この時期、すでに忙しい農作業の季節が最盛期を迎え、花の神に感謝し、新鮮な梅の実で酒を作ります。
local: at this time, the already busy farming season reaches its peak, paying thanks to the flower gods and making wine with fresh plum berries,
ja_pron: Kono jiki, sude ni isogashii nōsagyō no kisetsu ga saiseiki o mukae, hana no kami ni kansha shi, shinsen na ume no mi de sake o tsukurimasu.
native: at this time, the already busy farming season reaches its peak, paying thanks to the flower gods and making wine with fresh plum berries,

en: all show the Chinese people's closeness and respect for nature.
zh: 這些都展現了中國人對自然的親近與尊重。
ja: これらはすべて、中国人の自然への親しみと敬意を示しています。
local: all show the Chinese people's closeness and respect for nature.
ja_pron: Korera wa subete, Chūgokujin no shizen e no shitashimi to keii o shimeshite imasu.
native: all show the Chinese people's closeness and respect for nature.

en: The English word season comes from the Latin verb severe, meaning to sow, where the east or west ideas related to the seasons are closely tied to farming.
zh: 英文單字season來自拉丁語動詞severe，意指播種，東方或西方關於季節的觀念與農業密切相關。
ja: 英語の「season」はラテン語の動詞「severe」から来ており、意味は「種をまく」で、東西の季節に関する考えは農業と密接に結びついています。
local: The English word season comes from the Latin verb severe, meaning to sow, where the east or west ideas related to the seasons are closely tied to farming.
ja_pron: Eigo no 'season' wa Raten-go no dōshi 'severe' kara kite ori, imi wa 'tane o maku' de, tōzai no kisetsu ni kansuru kangae wa nōgyō to missetsu ni musubitsuite imasu.
native: The English word season comes from the Latin verb severe, meaning to sow, where the east or west ideas related to the seasons are closely tied to farming.

en: But, out of the 24 Chinese solar terms, only one makes direct mention of agriculture, and that's the night, among John, rain in the ear.
zh: 但是，在24節氣中，只有一個直接提到農業，那就是芒種，意為“芒種時節的雨”。
ja: しかし、24節気の中で農業に直接言及しているのは一つだけで、それが芒種（ぼうしゅ）です。
local: But, out of the 24 Chinese solar terms, only one makes direct mention of agriculture, and that's the night, among John, rain in the ear.
ja_pron: Shikashi, 24 sekki no naka de nōgyō ni chokusetsu genkyū shite iru no wa hitotsu dake de, sore ga Bōshu desu.
native: But, out of the 24 Chinese solar terms, only one makes direct mention of agriculture, and that's the night, among John, rain in the ear.

en: Known to farmers as the busy planting period, each year, when mountain falls, you can bet that it's going to rain.
zh: 農民們知道這是忙碌的播種期，每年芒種時節，幾乎可以肯定會下雨。
ja: 農民たちはこれを忙しい植え付けの時期と知っており、毎年芒種の頃には雨が降るとほぼ確信しています。
local: Known to farmers as the busy planting period, each year, when mountain falls, you can bet that it's going to rain.
ja_pron: Nōmin-tachi wa kore o isogashii uetsuke no jiki to shitte ori, maitoshi Bōshu no koro ni wa ame ga furu to hobo kakushin shite imasu.
native: Known to farmers as the busy planting period, each year, when mountain falls, you can bet that it's going to rain.

en: So, farmers are racing to bring in the harvests before the rains come, and plant seeds for the next season to safeguard future harvest.
zh: 因此，農民們爭分奪秒地在雨季來臨前收割，並為下一季播種以保障未來的收成。
ja: そのため、農民たちは雨が降る前に収穫を急ぎ、次の季節のために種をまいて将来の収穫を守ります。
local: So, farmers are racing to bring in the harvests before the rains come, and plant seeds for the next season to safeguard future harvest.
ja_pron: Sonotame, nōmin-tachi wa ame ga furu mae ni shūkaku o isogi, tsugi no kisetsu no tame ni tane o maite shōrai no shūkaku o mamorimasu.
native: So, farmers are racing to bring in the harvests before the rains come, and plant seeds for the next season to safeguard future harvest.

en: It is a month.
zh: 這是一個月份。
ja: それは一ヶ月です。
local: It is a month.
ja_pron: Sore wa ikkagetsu desu.
native: It is a month.

en: The 24 solar terms were laid down by farmers 3,000 years ago to regulate how the land was to be worked.
zh: 24節氣是三千年前農民制定的，用來規範土地的耕作方式。
ja: 24節気は3000年前に農民たちによって定められ、土地の耕作方法を規制するためのものでした。
local: The 24 solar terms were laid down by farmers 3,000 years ago to regulate how the land was to be worked.
ja_pron: 24 sekki wa 3000 nen mae ni nōmin-tachi ni yotte sadamerare, tochi no kōsaku hōhō o kisei suru tame no mono deshita.
native: The 24 solar terms were laid down by farmers 3,000 years ago to regulate how the land was to be worked.

en: And, today, 3,000 years later, they're still following to the Latin.
zh: 而今天，三千年後，人們仍然遵循這些節氣。
ja: そして今日、3000年後も人々はこれらの節気に従っています。
local: And, today, 3,000 years later, they're still following to the Latin.
ja_pron: Soshite kyō, 3000-nen go mo hitobito wa korera no sekki ni shitagatte imasu.
native: And, today, 3,000 years later, they're still following to the Latin.

en: Hernan province on the plains of the Yellow River has four distinct seasons, plenty of sunshine and loads of rain.
zh: 黃河平原上的河南省有四季分明，陽光充足且雨量豐沛。
ja: 黄河平原にある河南省は四季がはっきりしており、日照も多く雨も豊富です。
local: Hernan province on the plains of the Yellow River has four distinct seasons, plenty of sunshine and loads of rain.
ja_pron: Kōga heigen ni aru Kanan-shō wa shiki ga hakkiri shite ori, nisshō mo ōku ame mo hōfu desu.
native: Hernan province on the plains of the Yellow River has four distinct seasons, plenty of sunshine and loads of rain.

en: Hernan is the most important wheat-producing province in China, and where I am now,
zh: 河南是中國最重要的小麥生產省份，而我現在所在的地方，
ja: 河南は中国で最も重要な小麦生産省であり、私が今いる場所は、
local: Hernan is the most important wheat-producing province in China, and where I am now,
ja_pron: Kanan wa Chūgoku de mottomo jūyō na komugi seisan-shō de ari, watashi ga ima iru basho wa,
native: Hernan is the most important wheat-producing province in China, and where I am now,

en: Xianchao, is key to China's grain production might.
zh: 咸朝，是中國糧食生產力量的關鍵。
ja: 咸朝は中国の穀物生産力の鍵となっています。
local: Xianchao, is key to China's grain production might.
ja_pron: Kanchō wa Chūgoku no kokumotsu seisanryoku no kagi to natte imasu.
native: Xianchao, is key to China's grain production might.

en: When mandram arrives, all this wheat needs to be harvested, and fast.
zh: 當芒種來臨時，所有這些小麥都需要迅速收割。
ja: 芒種が来ると、このすべての小麦を迅速に収穫しなければなりません。
local: When mandram arrives, all this wheat needs to be harvested, and fast.
ja_pron: Bōshu ga kuru to, kono subete no komugi o jinsoku ni shūkaku shinakereba narimasen.
native: When mandram arrives, all this wheat needs to be harvested, and fast.

en: Right now, this is quite possibly the busiest place in the whole country.
zh: 現在，這裡可能是全國最繁忙的地方。
ja: 今、ここはおそらく全国で最も忙しい場所です。
local: Right now, this is quite possibly the busiest place in the whole country.
ja_pron: Ima, koko wa osoraku zenkoku de mottomo isogashii basho desu.
native: Right now, this is quite possibly the busiest place in the whole country.

en: They call it the wheat championships.
zh: 他們稱之為小麥錦標賽。
ja: 彼らはそれを小麦選手権と呼んでいます。
local: They call it the wheat championships.
ja_pron: Karera wa sore o komugi senshuken to yonde imasu.
native: They call it the wheat championships.

en: Based on each household's production of wheat per move or six acres,
zh: 根據每戶每畝或六英畝的小麥產量，
ja: 各家庭の一畝または六エーカーあたりの小麦生産量に基づいて、
local: Based on each household's production of wheat per move or six acres,
ja_pron: Kaku katei no ichibu matawa roku ēkā atari no komugi seisanryō ni motozuite,
native: Based on each household's production of wheat per move or six acres,

en: they crown a champion farmer wheat king every year.
zh: 他們每年都會加冕一位冠軍農民小麥王。
ja: 彼らは毎年、チャンピオン農民、小麦王を称えます。
local: they crown a champion farmer wheat king every year.
ja_pron: Karera wa maitoshi, chanpion nōmin, komugi ō o tataemasu.
native: they crown a champion farmer wheat king every year.

en: Marco Fu has been the village leader here for more than 30 years.
zh: 馬可·傅已經擔任這裡的村長超過30年。
ja: マルコ・フーはここで30年以上村長を務めています。
local: Marco Fu has been the village leader here for more than 30 years.
ja_pron: Maruko Fū wa koko de 30-nen ijō sonchō o tsutomete imasu.
native: Marco Fu has been the village leader here for more than 30 years.

en: In years gone by, every single stalk of wheat was harvested manually.
zh: 過去，每一根小麥莖都是手工收割的。
ja: 昔は、小麦の一本一本を手作業で収穫していました。
local: In years gone by, every single stalk of wheat was harvested manually.
ja_pron: Mukashi wa, komugi no ippon ippon o tesagyo de shūkaku shite imashita.
native: In years gone by, every single stalk of wheat was harvested manually.

en: Old Mar was known as the best hand at the job.
zh: 老馬被認為是這項工作的最佳能手。
ja: 老マルコはその仕事の名人として知られていました。
local: Old Mar was known as the best hand at the job.
ja_pron: Rō Maruko wa sono shigoto no meijin to shite shirarete imashita.
native: Old Mar was known as the best hand at the job.

en: He was crowned the wheat king.
zh: 他被加冕為小麥王。
ja: 彼は小麦王に冠されました。
local: He was crowned the wheat king.
ja_pron: Kare wa komugi ō ni kanmuri saremashita.
native: He was crowned the wheat king.

zh: 你買牛奶了嗎？
ja: 牛乳を買いましたか？
local: Did you buy milk?
ja_pron: Gyūnyū o kaimashita ka?
native: Did you buy milk?

en: He had his insistence on reading these Jackson planes.
zh: 他堅持閱讀這些傑克遜飛機。
ja: 彼はこれらのジャクソン飛行機を読むことにこだわっていました。
local: He had his insistence on reading these Jackson planes.
ja_pron: Kare wa korera no Jakuson hikōki o yomu koto ni kodawatte imashita.
native: He had his insistence on reading these Jackson planes.

ja: 1エーカーの土地は、イギリスの1エーカーの土地の6倍の人口を養うことができました。

ja_pron: 1 ēkā no tochi wa, Igirisu no 1 ēkā no tochi no 6-bai no jinkō o yashinau koto ga dekimashita.

ja_pron: Chūgoku no nōmin no surudoi taimingu kankaku ga ōkiku kankei shite ita ni chigai arimasen.
native: lot to do with Chinese farmers' acute sense of timing.

en: As old Mars said, scientific cultivation and better field management have increased the wheat yield considerably.
zh: 正如老馬所說，科學耕作和更好的田間管理大大提高了小麥產量。
ja: 老マルコが言ったように、科学的な栽培とより良い畑の管理が小麦の収量を大幅に増加させました。
local: As old Mars said, scientific cultivation and better field management have increased the wheat yield considerably.
ja_pron: Rō Maruko ga itta yō ni, kagakuteki na saibai to yori yoi hatake no kanri ga komugi no shūryō o ōhaba ni zōka sasemashita.
native: As old Mars said, scientific cultivation and better field management have increased the wheat yield considerably.

ja: 機械化された収穫により、芒種は以前よりずっと簡単になりました。
local: Mechanized harvesting has meant that mountain-drawn is way easier than it was,
ja_pron: Kikaika sareta shūkaku ni yori, Bōshu wa izen yori zutto kantan ni narimashita.
native: Mechanized harvesting has meant that mountain-drawn is way easier than it was,

ja: これにより、非常に起業家的な地元の人々が新しいビジネスチャンスを探すようになりました。
